content:
Verify all below and fix if you have not.

 Critical — Security
#	Issue	Detail
1	Twilio credentials in APK	build.gradle.kts compiles TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID + TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN into BuildConfig. They're then sent as plain HTTP headers from the Android app. Anyone decompiling the APK extracts your Twilio keys.
2	Hardcoded Supabase URL	SupabaseAuth.kt:33 has the full project URL https://klmgvvsikkhzgfxfujua.supabase.co/functions/v1/send-sms as a fallback — leaks your Supabase project ID.
3	No RLS policy verification	Supabase tables have user_id columns but the Kotlin SupabaseRepository filters by profile_id, not auth.uid(). Relies entirely on the anon key Bearer token pattern which provides no row-level isolation.
4	Access token ephemeral	_accessToken is an in-memory MutableStateFlow. Process death = token lost. No refresh token persistence. No EncryptedSharedPreferences.
🔴 Critical — Architecture
#	Issue	Detail
5	God ViewModel (1024 lines)	AppViewModel.kt manages auth, kids, meals, camps, appointments, streaks, notifications, wearables, family sharing, food recognition, AI, theme, locale, consent AND Supabase sync. Violates every SOLID principle.
6	Dual storage = no single source of truth	JSON file is primary read path; Room DB is write-only dead code for reads. If JSON corrupts, Room data is never used for recovery. fallbackToDestructiveMigration() on Room destroys all data on schema change.
7	No offline-first strategy	Every Supabase call is try { } catch (_: Exception) { } — sync failures are silently swallowed. No retry queue, no conflict resolution, no user-facing sync status.
🟡 High — Incomplete/Pretend Features
#	Feature	Reality
8	Food Recognition	Camera shows placeholder. "Detected food" is hardcoded demo data. No ML/vision API integration.
9	AI Diet Coach	buildPersonalizedTip() uses hardcoded if/else rules. generateAIContent() is delay(1800) + static text. Not calling any AI API.
10	Leaderboard	badgeProgressForKid() generates fake entries ("Hero #214"). No Supabase query for real multi-user data.
11	Family Sharing	joinFamily() adds a local CoParent object only. No server-side code validation. Co-parents can't view shared kid data.
12	Wearable/Health Connect	getDemoData() returns deterministic fake data based on name.hashCode(). No actual Health Connect API calls.
🟡 Medium — Technical Debt
#	Issue
13	Koin in dependencies but unused — manual viewModel() everywhere; VitaHeroDatabase.getInstance() is a hand-rolled singleton
14	Notification scheduler uses hardcoded English strings — bypasses the entire locale/translation system
15	Exact alarm permission never requested at runtime on Android 14+ — SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM declared only in manifest
16	No ProGuard/R8 — isMinifyEnabled = false, no code shrinking or obfuscation
17	Zero tests — no unit tests, UI tests, or integration tests
18	vitahero://auth deep link registered but never handled in MainActivity
19	No crash reporting, analytics, or structured logging framework
20	LocaleStrings.kt is 774 lines but ~40% of UI strings are still hardcoded in screens (AuthScreen alone has 15+ hardcoded English strings)



I hope you have taken care of below as well.

Security (move Twilio to Deno env, harden Supabase RLS)
Architecture (split ViewModel, fix data layer)
Complete fake features (wire real AI, food recognition, leaderboard)
Hardening (exact alarm, ProGuard, deep links, locale coverage)
